answer: A newcomer earns standing by carrying a beacon through a relay: each season it must hand the beacon to a stranger in a new trade, who keeps it only after checking the newcomer's real work and passing it onward. The reef keeps a public record of every handoff, so a farm's beacons circle only among its own fakes and the loop shows at once. Standing grows only as the beacon travels through unrelated hands, and a sparrow-small bond is staked on each pass, so a dropped beacon or broken relay costs the whole chain. Honest beacons travel farther each season; fakes stall without fresh strangers.
